construct:binding.note: a {{ }} binding: the route reads what it renders, not the binding. readBinding routes each to the place it fills; Fill writes the text, styles and links it renders (fillSurface); a binding that renders unresolved is a draft defect (unresolvedBindingDefects). A handler, ref or loop list it fills is its own capability (construct:handler and construct:ref wait in behaviour recognisers), and so is a form attribute

construct:data-hook.note: a script that finds its elements by a data-* hook is recognised by what it does to them (lib/motion-behaviours.mjs: the effects by mechanism, the settings behaviours); a hook whose behaviour no recogniser expresses is raised as an unmapped row naming the mechanism (FR-48-80)

construct:dc-import.note: an import host: the component it stamps read from the export (readImport); elements inside it carry the host in their draft identity, so they are proposed and paired like the page's own

construct:getter.note: a logic getter: read through its component's own reads and the template expressions that name it (readGetter; one nothing reads is reported as unused); its values reach the page through the bindings that use them, as construct:renderVals-key

construct:handler.note: an event handler is recognised by the behaviour it drives: a state-started entrance (the open and exit layers), a scroll-position write (the header settings), a press scroll (native); one no recogniser expresses is raised as an unmapped row (FR-48-80)

construct:helmet-font.note: a font loaded in the helmet (stylesheet, @import or @font-face), read by readHelmetFont; the snapshot's self-hosted faces take its families and weights, checked by head-check.mjs::fontCheck

construct:helmet-script.note: a head script: read through the constructs the census finds in it (readHelmetScript), each written under its own kind (its animations by the motion writer); the custom elements it defines are html:custom-element

construct:keyframes.note: CSS animations: entrances as entrance.base (keyframes when there are more than two stops), endless ones as effects

construct:link.note: a link by its address (readLink): anchors, contact links, bound, external and page addresses (a hash route is the permalink of its page map page) reach the link decisions; a head link (a font host or stylesheet) is the document's: stylesheets are read by the CSS readers, fonts are the snapshot's (construct:helmet-font, site and surfaces); javascript: and data: addresses are named as such

construct:observer.note: an observer the draft starts (scroll position, intersection) is recognised by the behaviour it writes: scroll-progress, parallax, the pinned timeline settings, the scrolled header; one no recogniser expresses is raised as an unmapped row (FR-48-80)

excluded.reason: a DOM handle in the draft's script: wiring only, the effect each one drives is cloned through its target

construct:renderVals-key.note: a renderVals key: read through the template expressions that use it (readRenderKey; one no expression uses is reported as unused dead code); its values reach the page through those bindings, whose rendered results Fill writes and whose unresolved ones are draft defects

construct:sc-for.note: a loop: its list and item name read (readLoop); the skeleton inventory carries each stamped item's loop membership, so repeated items are proposed and paired as one repeat

construct:sc-if.note: a condition: read by the inventory as the state that shows its branch (lib/intake-inventory.mjs::readInventory); the state map reaches each one by a walker state, by setting its state keys, or lists it as a gap; the keys are set through the runtime's own setState, the branch's looks read and the state put back, and fillStates writes them into the setting state the map names (lib/fill-logic-state.mjs::readLogicStates). A condition reached only by a walker state or a gap row has no look read here

construct:style-hover.note: a style-* pseudo rule: the draft runtime compiles it into a stylesheet rule, which the state reader reads as the hover (or focus) look and writes to the setting states; its motion is also written on hover.state (lib/fill-motion.mjs::motionWrites). A bound value ({{ }}) is a draft defect (FR-48-34) (tests/states-planted-draft.test.mjs)
